description: Owner only: import customers (and one service address each) from a CSV with the mapping the owner confirmed. mode all_or_nothing (default) writes nothing if any row fails; per_row writes the good rows and reports the rest. dry_run true checks without writing.

on_match.description: A row that matches a customer already in Doing Work (by old id, then email, then phone): skip (default) leaves it; update fills blanks, adds tags and a new service address, and never replaces an email or phone.

preview_hash.description: The preview_hash from imports.preview. When sent, the run is refused if the file or mapping changed since that preview.

source.description: Where the file came from (jobber, housecall_pro, ...). Old ids are remembered per source. Defaults to the preset, or csv.

name: imports_run
